"%1$s new reading files · tap to view"
"Next volume pending: unknown size or storage limit reached. You can download it manually."
"Black text, white background and static controls. Page curl and continuous reading are suspended without deleting your settings."
"Request a clean refresh from the Bigme controller. Enable it and try “Refresh screen now”. Disable it if it does not help. It is disabled after a firmware change."
"Bigme refresh requested after navigation; still needs checking on your screen."
"BOOX controller detected; panel refresh still needs checking."
"Compatibility redraw. Also enable full refresh in your device settings."
"Refreshing causes a deliberate flash and adds a delay. It runs after navigation or scrolling ends, not during the gesture. You can disable it without changing the theme."

"Uses Bigme\'s global refresh command with the mode supplied by its firmware. The community documented this API on another Bigme; it has not yet been validated on B751C S with system 1.7.0. Accepting the command does not prove it removes ghosting."
"A full refresh will be requested from the BOOX controller. Results depend on the firmware and must be checked on the reader."

"No compatible native controller is active. The entire window is redrawn with a black/white cycle; this does not guarantee a physical refresh. Also enable full refresh per page in your device settings."
"You can export detection status from My space → Diagnostics. It does not include a serial number or account details."
"Use Quality/Normal for text and images; A2/Fast may leave more ghosting. The app does not control the keyboard or Android dialogs. It does not change brightness or system settings."
"Original colours are preserved. Resolution, contrast and refresh time depend on the panel; not all colour devices use the same controller."
"Long-press the text and select part of a paragraph before adding a note."
"Choose an installed app to look up only this selection. Offline availability depends on its downloaded dictionaries."
"No compatible apps installed. Install a dictionary that supports Android\'s Process text action."
"Enter at least two characters. Searches all downloaded sections."
"Select text in the book and choose “Highlight / Note”, or use that action in Tools."

"Uses an installed offline voice. Continues through the book\'s sections without marking it as finished. Keeps playing with the screen off. Pause using the notification or headphones. Pauses when audio focus is lost or headphones are disconnected."
"Open Android Settings → Text-to-speech to install a voice."
"Could not connect securely. Check your server and connection."
"Independent app · Alpha version\nYour password is not saved. Downloads stay on this device."
"Could not connect. Downloaded content is still available."
"Could not load Kavita. Your downloads remain available; you can retry."
"Could not reach Kavita. Showing the saved catalogue."
"Try another title or change the library filter."
"Connect to Kavita and tap refresh. Downloads do not need a connection."
"You can keep reading offline. Your progress is saved here until you reconnect."
"Your local copy and progress are kept."
"Saved on this device · waiting to sync"
"The API does not report an edit timestamp. We do not pick a version based on when it was downloaded."
"Also changed on another device. Choose which position to keep."
"Already downloaded items are not downloaded again."
"Preparation stopped. Added items remain in Downloads."
"No %1$s loaded. If you are offline, open Downloads."
"%1$s %2$s · %3$s pages/sections. They will be saved one at a time. "
"They will wait for an unmetered network. "
"The final size depends on images and resources. You can pause each download."
"The batch did not finish. Check Downloads before retrying."

"Wi-Fi only uses unmetered networks. Changes also apply to pending downloads without clearing the queue. Manually paused downloads remain paused. Progress can still sync over mobile data. Android may delay background work."
"Pending reading and bookmark changes in this app replace Kavita\'s, even if the web client is further ahead. With no local changes, changes from the web are received."
"If you also change a reading position or bookmark on the web, review the conflict before replacing it."
"Downloads and %1$s pending reading positions will be kept for this account. Sign in again with the same username to access them."
"The book contains external resources that cannot be downloaded safely"
"Too many linked resources in the EPUB"
"Could not complete the operation. Other downloads and your progress are kept."
"Applies to downloaded content, not the entire series in Kavita."
"Download from Library. Originals remain in Kavita."
"Try another title, type or reading status."
"All downloaded volumes or books have been read."
"Selected partial files will be deleted, not completed downloads. Progress and bookmarks are kept."
"%1$s reading files will be deleted from this device, including selected completed downloads. Kavita originals, progress and bookmarks are kept."
"Could not open or save the file. Your data is safe."
"Backup saved. It does not contain passwords or book files."
"Version, Android, download counts and HTTP codes. Does not include account, server, titles, text, notes, keys or full logs."
"Mark a series as a favourite from View volumes/books. You can access it here."
"Follow a series from its catalogue. It is checked on opening and roughly every 12 hours; Android may delay this."
"Check finished. Review each series for notices."
"Could not check Kavita. Retry when connected."
"You are not following any series yet."
"Counts from this version, only while the reader is open and visible. Visiting a page does not mean it has been read."

"Saves progress, bookmarks, notes, favourites, collections and settings. To restore on another device, sign in with the same account. Passwords and downloads are not included: books must be downloaded again."
"The backup contains your titles and annotations. Choose where to save it with Android\'s file picker."
"Clears local statistical history. Progress and bookmarks are unchanged."
"%1$s reading files, %2$s bookmarks and %3$s notes. Missing data will be added; your current positions, notes and downloads are kept. Restored progress must be checked against Kavita."
"Backup restored. Review Progress; your current downloads are kept."
"Does not delete books or resume paused volumes. The limit only counts automatically downloaded files; downloads stop at the limit. The general Wi-Fi-only setting is also respected."
"This book has no table of contents. You can select a section."
"Tap a thumbnail to open that page"
"The EPUB has %1$s sections; pagination changes with text size."
"Your progress is saved. Retry the download from Library."
"%1$s/%2$s available · %3$s. Your position is kept while the download continues."
"Reader. Tap the centre to show controls and the edges to turn pages."
"Reader. Tap to show controls. Swipe to turn pages; when zoomed in, swipe from an edge of the image."
"Reading preferences are saved for %1$s. Other series keep their settings."
"Using general settings. Enable this option to customise this series only."
"Switching volumes does not mark the current one as finished or skip volumes that have not been downloaded."
"Scroll vertically to read. With edge taps enabled, they jump to the start of the previous or next page. The centre shows controls."
"Tap the left or right edge to turn pages, even while zoomed in. Tap the centre to show or hide controls. Drag to pan the enlarged image."
"Swipe horizontally to turn pages. When zoomed in, drag to pan; once at an edge, swipe outwards again to turn the page. Tap to show or hide controls."
"Edges respond when you lift your finger. Pinch or double-tap the centre to zoom. Manga reading direction is respected."
"Page curl only applies to the paged reader. Your choice is kept when you return to that mode."
"Page curl simulates a fold when moving forwards or backwards, with swipes or taps and while zoomed in. If Android disables animations, pages turn without effects."
"Volume − moves forwards; volume + moves backwards. During speech or with a dialog open, the buttons still control audio."

"Scroll up or down to read continuously. Edges and the selector jump to the start of a page. The position within the image is saved on this device. To zoom or use Page curl, switch back to Full page."
"%1$s/%2$s pages or sections available. %3$s. Reading is not marked as finished."
"The previous page and your progress are kept. Retry the page turn; if it keeps failing, download this volume again."
"Syncs with Kavita when connected. Changes on this device take priority."
"Syncs with Kavita when connected. Review conflicts in Progress."
"%1$s is not downloaded or has changed edition. Download it from Library to continue. No volumes are skipped."
"You have reached the end of this series\' saved catalogue."
"The backup exceeds the 16 MB size limit"
"This backup belongs to another server or user. Sign in with the original account."

"You can allow installation and try again whenever you want."

"It will download automatically on an unmetered Wi-Fi network."
"Check for a new version of Troop Reader."
"Checks on opening the app and periodically in the background. Android may delay checks. Installation always requires confirmation and does not interrupt reading."
